messages:
mira: Quick follow-up from the DB failover postmortem — we need concrete owners and timelines for the remediation items and runbook updates. Main takeaways: failovers clustered around schema migration window, handoff/coordination gaps, and triage steps missing. Can folks pick items so we can close the postmortem action list?

 dan: I can take the migration pre-check checklist and add explicit commands to the runbook. Will open a runbooks PR by EOD Wed. My checks to add: `ps aux | grep redwood-db`, `pg_isready -h $HOST -p $PORT`, `SELECT state FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%ALTER TABLE%';` and a note to pause migrations if replication lag > 5s.

 alex: I'll own the alerting/automation item — prototype a Prometheus rule + Grafana dashboard for replication lag and stuck DDL. ETA two weeks. Creating RED-1243 and will link the dashboard in the PR.

 sara: Oncall triage updates: I'll insert a short triage checklist at the top of the runbook with exact commands for first responders and clear escalation path. Steps: 1) run `ss -tnlp | grep 5432`, 2) `docker ps --filter name=redwood-db`, 3) check `pg_isready` and `pg_replication_slots`. If unresolved after 15m, page infra-team (pager: #infra-pager). I'll include exact sample output to help quick decisions. PR tomorrow morning.

 beth: Noting a recurring pattern: many of these incidents happen during low-load migration windows when checkpointing is delayed. Suggest adding a rollback/fallback subsection (how to abort a migration safely) and explicit RTO/RPO guidance. Also add a link to the mitigation playbook for rolling back: include commands and cautions e.g., do NOT run `pg_stop_backup()` unless you're sure — include checklist.

 oncall-bot: Created follow-up tasks in issues: RED-1243 (alerts), RED-1244 (migration checks), RED-1245 (runbook triage). Marking postmortem as having open actions.

 mira: Great. Recording owners + deadlines here so we have a single source: dan -> migration pre-checks (PR by Wed, deploy to runbooks by Apr 8), alex -> alerts/dashboard (prototype in 2w, checklist in runbook by Apr 15), sara -> oncall triage + escalation edits (PR tomorrow), beth -> rollback section + RTO/RPO guidance (draft by Apr 5). If anyone needs to adjust dates, reply here.

 dan: Small note on commands: I'll include a small script snippet in the runbook for quick validation:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
HOST=$1
PORT=${2:-5432}
pg_isready -h $HOST -p $PORT || exit 1
ps aux | grep redwood-db | grep -v grep || echo 'db process missing'
# check replication lag
psql -c "SELECT now()-pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp() AS lag"
```

 alex: For alerts, I'll make the alert severity map to paging vs. slack-only. Replication lag > 10s will page, >5s only slack. Will add runbook note about when to escalate.

 mira: Also important: update the escalation path with names + pager numbers for on-call rotations (include primary, secondary, infra contact). Put an explicit recovery checklist at top so responders can run through minimal triage in <5m.

 beth: I can review the rollback instructions and validate the safety steps. Will leave comments on PR.

 sara: One more: add a short blameless-note template to the runbook so responders can attach initial findings to the postmortem page (helps speed up writeups).

 mira: Thanks all — I'll update the postmortem doc with these owners and link the runbook PRs as they land. Please paste PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
